_schema._doctrine: The tuple and the outcome. NEVER the request text. Request text in a research organisation is itself sensitive, and a governance tool that stored it would inherit every restriction it exists to route around. tools/validate.py fails the build if a banned field appears here.
_schema.received_at: ISO 8601. When intake started. Required for the latency metric.
_schema.resolved_at: ISO 8601. When a usable path was returned. Required for the latency metric.
_schema.latency_seconds: integer, resolved_at - received_at. Denormalised so /scorecard needs no date parsing.
_schema.confidence: high | medium | low, on the classification itself
_schema.sla_days: integer or null, from the ruleset cell
_schema.clarifying_rounds: integer. More than 3 is a taxonomy defect, logged as an open item.

_note: WORKED EXAMPLE, not a real intake. Two rows so /scorecard has a shape to read before the first real request. Delete both on first production use.
